summary: A 40-year-old general-category male farmer in rural Uttar Pradesh, family income under ₹1 lakh, no disability.
why: PM-KISAN, PM Fasal Bima, and Kisan Credit Card are central farmer schemes. PMSBY is open at age 40. The ST post-matric scholarship, Matru Vandana (women), Stand-Up India (he is not SC/ST), the ICAR SC/ST scholarship, Tamil Nadu disability pension, UP divyang pension, and the UP leprosy pension do not fit.

summary: An 18-year-old Scheduled Caste woman student in urban Bihar, family income under ₹1 lakh, no disability.
why: The ICAR post-matric scholarship is for SC/ST students aged 18 to 35. Farmer schemes, Matru Vandana (official age filter starts at 21), Stand-Up India (self-employment), the ST-only post-matric scholarship, a Gujarat SC scholarship, and a Karnataka weaver scheme do not fit. The ICAR page still requires admission in an agricultural university.

summary: A 32-year-old general-category woman entrepreneur in urban Maharashtra, family income ₹2.5–5 lakh, no disability.
why: Stand-Up India matches because the official text says a male applicant must be SC/ST, so a woman is not limited to those categories, and the employment facet is self-employed. PMSBY covers age 32. Farmer schemes, the rural-only crop insurance scheme, a Gujarat men-only scheme, Ujjwala (marked below poverty line), and the ST scholarship do not fit.

summary: A 67-year-old OBC man in rural Karnataka with a disability, unemployed, family income under ₹1 lakh.
why: PMSBY covers ages 18 to 70. Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension is a central disability scheme and is marked below poverty line, so the lowest income band is shown with a confirmation note. Farmer, self-employment, student, and maternity schemes do not fit. The disability pension text also requires more than 80% disability.

summary: A 29-year-old Scheduled Tribe woman farmer in rural Telangana, family income ₹1–2.5 lakh, no disability.
why: Central farmer schemes plus Telangana Rythu Bima match. Stand-Up India matches a woman entrepreneur path and also an ST applicant. Student scholarships, Tamil Nadu disability pension, and the Uttar Pradesh pre-matric scholarship (ages 14–18) do not fit. Rythu Bima still requires a Telangana land record.
